observation: Fresh main now fails closed on malformed package.json, but a declared npm workspace with no root validation scripts still silently treated failed, missing, or malformed `npm pkg get scripts --workspaces --json` inspection as an empty workspace script set. In mixed-language repositories that could again omit JavaScript workspace validation while other validators proceed.
changes: Fail npm workspace script discovery when the npm inspection process errors, exits non-zero, or returns no output.
Fail explicitly when npm workspace discovery output is not valid JSON.
Reuse the existing structured VALIDATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED acceptance boundary while preserving root-script discovery that does not need workspace inspection.

verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: unavailable/malformed workspace discovery fails closed; root-script validation discovery remains independent of npm workspace inspection.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/acceptance-npm-workspace-discovery-integrity.test.mjs covers missing npm inspection and root-script compatibility.

truth_boundary: This cycle only makes declared npm workspace validation discovery observable and fail-closed. It does not require npm workspaces to expose any particular validation script and does not invent new validation commands.
